basic_details.job_title: Panjab University Constituent College Security Guard Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Panjab University Constituent College, Patto Hira Singh, Nihal Singh Wala (Moga) has invited applications for the position of one Security Guard on daily wages at the current D.C. rate of Chandigarh against a vacant post. Eligible candidates must submit their properly completed application forms in the office of the Principal PU Constituent College, Nihal Singh Wala (Moga) by 04/11/2026 (5.00 PM).

content_sections.heading: About PU Security Guard
content_sections.text: Panjab University Constituent College located at Patto Hira Singh, Nihal Singh Wala (Moga) functions under Panjab University, Chandigarh. The institution has announced a recruitment notice for filling one vacant position of Security Guard on daily wages to support campus security operations.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit properly completed application forms in the office of the Principal PU Constituent College, Nihal Singh Wala (Moga). The application form is available for download on the Panjab University Website at https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/class-c-NT-position.pdf?124810171424. Applications must reach the office on or before 04/11/2026 (5.00 PM). FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams?
